panels.title: Memory writes (24h)
panels.description: learning_complete events in the last 24h, with a sparkline of the hourly trend.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, COUNT(*) AS writes FROM agent_events WHERE event = 'learning_complete' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, COUNT(*) AS writes FROM agent_events WHERE event = 'learning_complete' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recall failures (24h)
panels.description: memory_recall_failed + memory_recall_degraded + memory_graph_recall_failed in the last 24h. Green when clean, red when failures accumulate.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('memory_recall_failed','memory_recall_degraded','memory_graph_recall_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('memory_recall_failed','memory_recall_degraded','memory_graph_recall_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Memory event mix (24h)
panels.description: Distribution of memory-related events over the last 24h: writes (learning_complete), recall hits, and the three recall-failure types. Shows whether memory activity is healthy reads/writes or dominated by failures.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(event='learning_complete') AS learning_complete, SUM(event='recall_hit') AS recall_hit, SUM(event='memory_recall_degraded') AS memory_recall_degraded, SUM(event='memory_recall_failed') AS memory_recall_failed, SUM(event='memory_graph_recall_failed') AS memory_graph_recall_failed FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('learning_complete','recall_hit','memory_recall_degraded','memory_recall_failed','memory_graph_recall_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(event='learning_complete') AS learning_complete, SUM(event='recall_hit') AS recall_hit, SUM(event='memory_recall_degraded') AS memory_recall_degraded, SUM(event='memory_recall_failed') AS memory_recall_failed, SUM(event='memory_graph_recall_failed') AS memory_graph_recall_failed FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('learning_complete','recall_hit','memory_recall_degraded','memory_recall_failed','memory_graph_recall_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Memory write-rate vs recall failures (per hour, 24h)
panels.description: Hourly trend correlating memory writes (learning_complete) against recall failures and degraded recalls. When failures spike alongside or instead of writes, recall health is degrading. This is the core memory-health correlation.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(event='learning_complete') AS writes, SUM(event='recall_hit') AS recall_hits, SUM(event IN ('memory_recall_failed','memory_recall_degraded','memory_graph_recall_failed')) AS failures FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('learning_complete','recall_hit','memory_recall_failed','memory_recall_degraded','memory_graph_recall_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(event='learning_complete') AS writes, SUM(event='recall_hit') AS recall_hits, SUM(event IN ('memory_recall_failed','memory_recall_degraded','memory_graph_recall_failed')) AS failures FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('learning_complete','recall_hit','memory_recall_failed','memory_recall_degraded','memory_graph_recall_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Memory activity by hour-of-day (7d)
panels.description: When memory reads/writes happen across the day. Writes (learning_complete) and recall hits bucketed by local hour-of-day over the last 7 days. Surfaces overnight reflection/consolidation windows vs interactive daytime activity.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', ts) AS INTEGER) AS hour, SUM(event='learning_complete') AS writes, SUM(event='recall_hit') AS recall_hits FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('learning_complete','recall_hit') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', ts) AS INTEGER) AS hour, SUM(event='learning_complete') AS writes, SUM(event='recall_hit') AS recall_hits FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('learning_complete','recall_hit') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

panels.title: Working memory (active entries)
panels.description: Current working_memory entries that have not expired. Detail view — working memory is intentionally small and short-lived.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT written_at, written_by, content, expires_at FROM working_memory WHERE expires_at IS NULL OR julianday(expires_at) > julianday('now') ORDER BY written_at DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT written_at, written_by, content, expires_at FROM working_memory WHERE expires_at IS NULL OR julianday(expires_at) > julianday('now') ORDER BY written_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Dangling-active rows (live)
panels.description: memory_dangling_active from /integrity: active memories_meta rows with no live vector. Guards #803/#822 -- must stay 0; a non-zero value means a delete path is again leaving meta rows without vectors.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT value AS "dangling" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_dangling_active' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
targets.queryText: SELECT value AS "dangling" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_dangling_active' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: FTS coverage % (live)
panels.description: memory_fts_coverage_pct: memories_fts rows / live vectors. Should track 100; a drop means FTS writes are being skipped (#804). Currently ~53% -- the open FTS gap.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT value AS "coverage" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_fts_coverage_pct' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
targets.queryText: SELECT value AS "coverage" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_fts_coverage_pct' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Memory integrity: active_meta vs live_vectors vs dangling
panels.description: The invariant the supersede/TTL fix guards. active_meta should equal live_vectors; dangling should be flat at 0. Divergence = a regression in the delete/supersede path.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, value AS "active_meta" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_active_meta' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, value AS "active_meta" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_active_meta' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY time

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, value AS "live_vectors" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_live_vectors' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, value AS "live_vectors" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_live_vectors' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY time

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, value AS "dangling_active" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_dangling_active' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, value AS "dangling_active" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_dangling_active' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY time

panels.title: FTS coverage % (trend)
panels.description: memory_fts_coverage_pct over time. Target 100. Sustained <90 means the FTS index is drifting out of sync with live vectors (#804).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, value AS "fts_coverage_pct" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_fts_coverage_pct' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, value AS "fts_coverage_pct" FROM host_metrics WHERE metric='memory_fts_coverage_pct' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY time

panels.title: Graph recall: success vs failed (per hour)
panels.description: memory_graph_recall_success vs memory_graph_recall_failed (#811b/d). The success event is the denominator that makes the graph-recall failure RATE measurable -- without it the audit's first-pass 'Graphiti is dead' read was wrong.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(event='memory_graph_recall_success') AS success, SUM(event='memory_graph_recall_failed') AS failed FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('memory_graph_recall_success','memory_graph_recall_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(event='memory_graph_recall_success') AS success, SUM(event='memory_graph_recall_failed') AS failed FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('memory_graph_recall_success','memory_graph_recall_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Embed/FTS write failures (24h)
panels.description: embed_write_failure events (#811c): provenance/FTS writes that failed in remember(). Previously logged at debug and invisible -- the silence that let FTS coverage drift. Should be 0.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM agent_events WHERE event = 'embed_write_failure' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM agent_events WHERE event = 'embed_write_failure' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
